title: 1권 9유닛 스토리북 · 3쪽
prompt: Flat vector illustration in the style of a modern children's English textbook: simple geometric shapes, bold flat solid colors, at most one flat darker shadow tone per object, clean smooth edges with no outlines or only very thin dark outlines, rounded friendly forms, no texture, no gradients, no watercolor, no paper grain, no photo-realism, no 3D render. Bright cheerful palette (red, orange, yellow, green, blue, sky blue). Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere in the image. Full illustrated scene: the background is made of a few large flat color shapes (ground, bushes, sky) with a calm plain sky area near the top, characters large and clearly visible. No text, no letters. Do NOT draw any speech bubbles, thought bubbles or empty white balloons of any kind. Letter trees are ordinary round leafy trees with small fruits (like an orchard); never shape trees, clouds, paths or any object like letters of the alphabet. Full-page picture-book illustration. Use the attached character sheet ONLY to copy how the characters look. Draw ONLY these characters: Grumble. Every other character on the sheet must NOT appear in this picture. Scene: A kind owl vet in a white coat and round glasses kneels and wraps a tiny bandage around the worm lying on a cardboard box; six boxes are stacked by the taxi with a glowing seed on the top one; six strawberries sit in a row on a box lid. Three new letter trees (V, W, X with their fruits) stand along the lane. Grumble stands in the lane without his pinecones, holding his lantern up with both paws and staring: it blazes like a star and lights the whole lane. Hidden in the picture: the vet, the six strawberries, the box. (The vet is a kind owl in a white coat and round glasses — an animal, not a human.) Characters: Grumble is a grumpy old raccoon standing on two legs, dark eye mask, a striped nightcap, holding a tiny candle lantern in one paw, frowning sleepily, slippers.
